name: happy-hour
author: Takaro
description: Timed boost events that fill your server at the times you choose. Schedule them with cron expressions in the config (default: Friday 20:00-22:00 UTC) or start one by hand with `happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier]`. While an event runs, players earn bonus currency on kills (base x (multiplier - 1)) and on playtime, can get extra item drops on kills, and the server gets start, reminder and end broadcasts. Players type `happyhour` to see the status and time left. Optional Discord announcements. The module pays its own bonus and never changes other modules' settings.
summary: Timed boost events to fill your server: schedule them with cron (default Friday 20:00-22:00 UTC) or start one with happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier]. During the event players get bonus currency on kills and playtime, optional bonus item drops, and start/reminder/end broadcasts. happyhour shows the status. Optional Discord announcements.

multiplier.title: Default multiplier
multiplier.description: Boost used when a schedule or the start command gives none. 2 = double: the bonus equals the base reward once more.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: When happy hour starts by itself. Cron format: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, in the time zone below. Example: '0 20 * * 5' = Friday 20:00. Leave empty to only start it by command.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for the schedules, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin' or 'America/New_York'. Unknown names fall back to UTC.

killBaseReward.title: Kill base reward
killBaseReward.description: Base currency per kill. Bonus per kill = base x (multiplier - 1). Set it to what your kill reward (e.g. economyUtils zombie kill reward) pays, so 2x really doubles it. 0 = no kill bonus.

playtimeBaseReward.title: Playtime base reward
playtimeBaseReward.description: Base currency per playtime interval. Every online player gets base x (multiplier - 1) per interval during happy hour. 0 = no playtime bonus.

playtimeIntervalMinutes.title: Playtime interval (minutes)
playtimeIntervalMinutes.description: How often online players get the playtime bonus during happy hour.

doubleDropItems.title: Bonus drop items
doubleDropItems.description: During happy hour a kill can give one random item from this list. Empty = no bonus drops.

doubleDropChance.title: Bonus drop chance (%)
doubleDropChance.description: Chance per kill to get a bonus drop.

reminderIntervalMinutes.title: Reminder interval (minutes)
reminderIntervalMinutes.description: Broadcast a reminder this often while happy hour runs. 0 = off.

preAnnounceMinutes.title: Heads-up before scheduled start (minutes)
preAnnounceMinutes.description: Broadcast a warning this many minutes before a scheduled happy hour. 0 = off.

maxAdminMinutes.title: Max length for manual start (minutes)
maxAdminMinutes.description: Longest happy hour the start command accepts.

notifyKillBonus.title: PM kill bonus
notifyKillBonus.description: Send the player a PM for every kill bonus (can be spammy).

notifyPlaytimeBonus.title: PM playtime bonus
notifyPlaytimeBonus.description: Send the player a PM when the playtime bonus is paid.

startMessage.title: Start message
startMessage.default: HAPPY HOUR! {multiplier} rewards for the next {timeLeft}. Kill, play and earn bonus {currency}! Type {prefix}happyhour for details.

updateMessage.title: Update message
updateMessage.default: Happy hour changed: {multiplier} rewards for the next {timeLeft}!
updateMessage.description: Sent when an admin restarts a running happy hour. Placeholders: {multiplier} {timeLeft} {minutes} {currency} {prefix}

reminderMessage.title: Reminder message
reminderMessage.default: Happy hour is on: {multiplier} rewards, {timeLeft} left!

endMessage.title: End message
endMessage.default: Happy hour is over. Thanks for playing!

preAnnounceMessage.title: Heads-up message
preAnnounceMessage.default: Happy hour starts in {minutes} minutes: {multiplier} rewards! Get online!

discordAnnounce.title: Announce on Discord
discordAnnounce.description: Also post start, end and heads-up messages to a Discord channel.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Channel for the Discord announcements. Takaro's Discord bot must be in your server.

permissions.description: Start and stop happy hour with the happyhour command.
Count = extra percent on this player's happy hour bonus currency (50 = +50%).

happyhour.description: Show happy hour status; admins can start or stop it.
happyhour.helpText: happyhour = status and time left. Admins: happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier], happyhour stop.

arguments.name: multiplier
arguments.helpText: Boost, e.g. 2 for double (start only, default from config)

on-kill.description: During happy hour: pay the kill bonus and roll the bonus drop.

tick.description: Every minute: start scheduled happy hours, send heads-ups and reminders, pay the playtime bonus, end expired events.
